summary.p1: In December 2023, The Guys Trip (TGT) tradition continued strong as five legendary mates—Fernando (Honored Mate), Colin, Warren, Paul, and Darion—descended upon the snow-covered wonderland of Lake Tahoe. With a week carved out of our busy lives, we came together for what can only be described as an epic mix of adventure, competition, and absolute debauchery.
summary.p2: Our days were spent carving through the slopes on our snowboards, pushing limits, and wiping out in spectacular fashion. When we weren’t conquering the mountains, we tested our luck in the casinos, some walking away victorious (BUFFALOOO!), others leaving donations to the house (Zeus let us down this time). Back at the Airbnb, the spirit of battle continued with intense board games, MTG commander, and Dungeons & Dragons sessions, where our imaginations ran wild (or at least as wild as they could with booze in hand).
summary.p3: Speaking of booze—there was plenty. Our nights were fueled by expertly crafted jungle juice, exotic beers, and enough seagrams to warm even the coldest Tahoe nights. The kitchen was always alive, with all of us contributing to feast-worthy meals that kept us going strong (Thanks Colin).
summary.p4: Lake Tahoe gave us everything we wanted—thrill, camaraderie, and stories that will last until the next TGT. Another year, another unforgettable trip. Where to next?
